metaTitle: Custom Death Note Portrait From Your Photo | Anime Cabinet
metaDescription: Order a hand-drawn custom Death Note portrait from your photo. Preview within 72 hours, unlimited free revisions, from $39.99. Start yours today.
description: Turn your favorite photo into a custom Death Note portrait with the tense, psychological-noir atmosphere fans love. Our human artists hand-draw each piece with stark contrast, muted tones, crimson accents, and dramatic lighting inspired by the series’ intelligent, morally ambiguous mood. The result is an original character portrait built around you—not a copied anime frame or a direct impersonation of Light, L, Misa, or another copyrighted character. Your expression, hairstyle, facial structure, and defining details remain recognizable while the surrounding artwork takes on a cinematic edge.

Choose a serious expression, a thoughtful stare, or a subtle smirk to shape the mood of your commission. You can request visual motifs such as a notebook, feather pen, red-and-black accents, a minimalist room, or a rival-genius composition for two people. High-contrast source photos usually work especially well, but our artists can help refine the lighting and composition during the process. Tell us about the atmosphere you want, who should appear, and any meaningful details you would like included. For more ideas, explore our guide to a [Death Note-inspired custom poster](/blog/death-note-inspired-custom-poster).

Every Anime Cabinet portrait is drawn by a human artist rather than produced with an automated filter. You receive a preview within 72 hours of ordering and unlimited free revisions, so you can request adjustments until the artwork feels right. The finished piece can be prepared as a digital keepsake or a custom anime portrait canvas for your wall, office, dorm, or studio. Death Note is one of 24 anime and cartoon-inspired styles available across [Anime Cabinet](/), alongside options such as [Naruto](/portraits/naruto), Jujutsu Kaisen, and Attack on Titan. Looking for a present? See our [best gifts for Death Note fans](/blog/best-gifts-for-death-note-fans).

faqs.q: Where can I order a custom Death Note portrait commission, and how much does it cost?
faqs.a: You can order a custom Death Note portrait directly from Anime Cabinet, with prices starting at $39.99. Select your preferred portrait option, upload your photo, and share your ideas for the mood, composition, and background. The final price can vary depending on factors such as the number of people, format, and requested details.

faqs.q: Can an artist turn my photo into a Death Note-style portrait, and what details should I provide?
faqs.a: Yes. A human artist can use your photo as the reference for an original Death Note-inspired portrait. Send a clear image showing the face, explain whether you want a serious, contemplative, or subtly mischievous expression, and mention preferred motifs such as notebook details, feather pens, red-and-black lighting, or a minimalist background. You can also request a couple or group composition. A preview arrives within 72 hours, and unlimited free revisions are included. Most commissions are completed after the preview and revision process, with timing depending on the complexity of the order and how quickly feedback is provided.
